items.raw_excerpt: If you're looking for a job in Norway, sending out applications will rarely be enough – networking is the name of the game.
items.summary_en: Finding a job in Norway is hard if you only send applications. Many jobs are filled through personal contacts, so networking is very important.

items.title_en: A hidden job market: why networking is key to finding a job in Norway

items.raw_excerpt: Whether it's sport, culture or crafts many people in Austria choose to join or start their own Verein, roughly translated as association or club. Here's what you should know.
items.summary_en: Many people in Austria join or start a club called a Verein. A Verein can be for sports, culture or crafts. Here is what you should know before you begin one.

items.raw_excerpt: Union Minister Gadkari approves LB Nagar–Hayathnagar double-decker corridor, five Telangana ropeways, three ROBs, and NH upgrades.

items.raw_excerpt: Americans in France usually need to file two sets of tax declarations - one in the US, one in France - and may also have to declare two sets of foreign bank accounts.

items.raw_excerpt: It's not Friday 13th that is considered a day of bad luck in Spain but Tuesday 13th. Read on to find out why as well as some of the strangest Spanish superstitions.
items.summary_en: In Spain, people fear Tuesday the 13th, not Friday the 13th. The fear comes from the number 13 and old Spanish traditions. The article also shares some of Spain's strangest superstitions.
items.summary_ko: 스페인에서는 금요일 13일이 아니라 화요일 13일을 불운한 날로 여긴다. 이런 믿음은 13이라는 숫자와 오래된 스페인 전통에서 나왔다. 기사에는 스페인의 가장 이상한 금기 몇 가지도 소개된다.
items.title_en: Why Tuesday the 13th Is a Bad Luck Day in Spain
